text:
elena: starting POC handoff for Beacon Data. Goal: 3-week integration, then evaluate Dedicated vs Private. Need a compact provisioning + access runflow SEs can follow.
tom: can we split into 'dev path' (hosted keys) and 'secure path' (VPC + customer KMS)? keeps call focused.
elena: yes. dev path first for engineering team. secure path run in parallel for security reviewers.
rishi: i'll draft the dev path steps: create ephemeral API key, set ttl, share sample SDK snippet, include latency checklist.
olivia: i'll own security intake and make sure SQA has what they need. mainly asking for SOC2 cert, pen-test cadence, and KMS option boolean (customer-owned yes/no).
elena: good. include requirement to confirm data classification (PII / internal / public). helps routing decisions.
tom: dev path runflow (short): 1) open ticket with customer contact + data class 2) create scoped API key (ephemeral 7d) 3) provide SDK snippet + rate limits 4) collect perf metrics 5) propose next step (dedicated reserve or VPC)
rishi: SDK snippet for SEs:
```npx @redwood/inference --apiKey=$REDWOOD_KEY predict --model=rwd-3b "what's the weather"
```
include simple curl fallback:
```ncurl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.com/v1/predict
```
this is minimal and helps them hit health checks.
olivia: security checklist items i'll pre-fill: SOC2 link, data retention (choices 30/90/365), KMS ownership, log access (redwood ops only / customer + redwood), encryption algorithms, incident SLAs. i'll attach doc to ticket #POC-512.
infra-bot: dedicated-pool: recommended config for 50-120 qps -> 4 x a100-equivalent, batch window 30ms, quantization candidate: int8.
tom: rishi, include a warmup note for dedicated: run synthetic traffic for 10m before cutover. mention canary route option (10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%).
rishi: will add quick terraform hint for infra teams to provision test namespace but keep it one-liner. example:
```nterraform apply -var='env=poc-beacon' -target=module.redwood_inference_namespace
```
elena: how do we handle API key rotation if POC extends? we don't want stale credentials floating.
olivia: recommend issuing keys with TTL and a refresh endpoint. SEs can request new keys via rwctl or via console. add rotation policy to runflow.
tom: pricing note for customer comms: show hosted dev cost estimate per 10k tokens for integration week, and a 30-day pro-rated dedicated reserve. include an overage policy: fallback to hosted at reduced priority but no hard downtime.
infra-bot: vpn-check snippet for VPC path:
```ncurl -v --cacert /etc/ssl/certs/customer.pem https://private-api.redwood.net/health --resolve 'private-api.redwood.net:443:10.10.8.22'
```
this confirms TLS + routing.
olivia: i'll request customer KMS ARN if they want CMEK. add guidance: if customer provides KMS, rotation and access audit is required.
rishi: i'll prepare the one-pager runflow and post link here. includes dev curl examples, VPC smoke tests, dedicated warmup, owners, and escalation path.
elena: owners: rishi (SE runflow doc), tom (pricing + canary ops), olivia (security intake), infra-bot keeps sizing suggestions. schedule customer kickoff for Tue 10am PT.
elena: last: remind SE to collect CIDR & peering contact before kickoff. small ask but saves time.
elena: thanks team — keep updates here. audit-bot: ticket POC-512 created for Beacon Data at 1993128000
